description: Agent Coordination: submit the roster of agents taking part in one job: each agent with its id, its name, a verifiable identity (a key id, a DID, a service account or a registry entry), its role and what it may read, write and approve; optionally the roles the job needs with whether each is required; and optionally every area that needs an approval, such as merges, spending or publishing. The signed report lists every agent as identified, unidentified or unnamed with its rights, every role with the agents holding it and every approval area with its approvers, and names rights no one can be held to: unnamed or unidentifiable agents holding write or approval rights, roles with no agent in them and one agent holding every approval; then approval areas nobody may approve, areas approved only by the agent that writes them, reading agents with no identity, agents with no role and roles the job does not list, with the fix for each. This reads the participants in one multi-agent job: whether an organisation keeps one current list of all its agents is wever_fleet-roster-check and whether one registry covers every deployed agent is wever_agent-registry-check. Verdict rights_unaccountable, rights_gaps, rights_unverified or rights_accountable. POST /api/coordination-roster-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-coordination-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-coordination/.

id.description: How the roster refers to the agent.

identity.description: A verifiable identity: a key id, a DID, a service account or a registry entry.

approvals.description: Every area that needs an approval, such as merges, spending or publishing.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

required.description: The job cannot run without it; true when left out.
